description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing IdMapping entities in a Room database within an Android application. It contains methods for inserting, updating, deleting, and querying IdMapping records related to cloud note IDs.
external_methods: suspend fun updateNoteExtras(localId: Long, cloudService: CloudService, extras: String?)
suspend fun getByLocalIdAndProvider(localId: Long, provider: CloudService): IdMapping?

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts one or more IdMapping entities into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing IdMapping entities in the database.

methods.name: updateNoteExtras
methods.description: Updates the extras field of a cloud_id record for a specific localNoteId and provider.

methods.name: deleteByLocalId
methods.description: Deletes IdMapping records with specified local IDs.

methods.name: setNotesToBeDeleted
methods.description: Marks notes as deleted locally based on their IDs.

methods.name: deleteAllMappingsFor
methods.description: Removes all mappings associated with a specific cloud service.

methods.name: getByLocalIdAndProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IdMapping for a given local ID and cloud provider.

methods.name: getNonRemoteByLocalId
methods.description: Retrieves a local IdMapping that does not have a remote provider.

methods.name: getAllByLocalId
methods.description: Fetches all IdMappings associated with a local ID.

methods.name: getAllByCloudService
methods.description: Fetches all IdMappings for a specific cloud provider.

methods.name: getCountByCloudService
methods.description: Returns the count of IdMappings for a specific cloud provider.
